title: Fewer marriages in 2023 in Singapore after surge in 2022
paragraphs: A total of 28,310 couples registered their marriages in 2023, down from 29,389 in 2022.
SINGAPORE-The post-pandemic wedding rush is over, as fewer couples tied the knot in 2023.
A total of 28,310 couples registered their marriages in 2023, a 3.7 per cent fall from the record high of 29,389 marriages in 2022.
“In 2023, there were over 28,000 marriages registered, which is over 2,000 marriages more than a decade ago. Overall, the five-year moving average for marriages has been stable,” he said.
The report showed that the proportion of men and women who were ever married, which includes those who are currently married, widowed or divorced, has fallen.
The proportion of male residents aged between 25 and 49 who were single increased from 31.2 per cent in 2013 to 35.4 per cent in 2023.
The corresponding figure for women was 25.1 per cent in 2013, and this rose to 28.7 per cent in 2023, an MSF spokeswoman told The Straits Times.
